title: geophila obvallata
intro: Geophila obvallata, commonly known as Spurred Coralroot, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Gentianaceae. The plant is known for its health benefits, which include the ability to act as a bronchodilator, helping to alleviate respiratory issues, and its potential to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing. Geophila obvallata exhibits therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents. Research suggests that the plant contains bioactive constituents including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
